ValidationRule.description: Brand-level products must not have a parent product. Fires only on create or when Parent Product / Product Type changes, so legacy rows can still be edited.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Parent_Product__c), ISCHANGED(Product_Type__c) ), ISPICKVAL(Product_Type__c, "Brand"), NOT(ISBLANK(Parent_Product__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Brand products cannot have a parent. Clear Parent Product.
